BEGIN;
WITH candidates AS (
 SELECT id FROM public.tender_agentic_jobs
 WHERE status IN ('ready','running','validating')
   AND (poll_owner_execution_id IS NULL OR poll_claimed_at < now() - interval '5 minutes')
 ORDER BY coalesce(heartbeat_at,created_at),id
 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
 LIMIT 2
), claimed AS (
 UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs j
 SET poll_owner_execution_id=$1::text,poll_claimed_at=now(),updated_at=now()
 FROM candidates c WHERE j.id=c.id
 RETURNING j.id,j.analysis_run_id,j.pipeline_version,j.replicate_index,j.status,j.field_catalog_version,
 j.field_catalog_sha256,j.input_manifest_sha256,j.poll_owner_execution_id
)
SELECT * FROM claimed;
COMMIT;

UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs
SET heartbeat_at=coalesce($3::timestamptz,now()),
 input_tokens=coalesce(($4::jsonb->>'input_tokens')::bigint,input_tokens),
 cached_input_tokens=coalesce(($4::jsonb->>'cached_input_tokens')::bigint,cached_input_tokens),
 output_tokens=coalesce(($4::jsonb->>'output_tokens')::bigint,output_tokens),
 reasoning_output_tokens=coalesce(($4::jsonb->>'reasoning_output_tokens')::bigint,reasoning_output_tokens),
 artifacts=artifacts || $5::jsonb,poll_owner_execution_id=NULL,poll_claimed_at=NULL,updated_at=now()
WHERE id=$1::uuid AND poll_owner_execution_id=$2::text AND status IN ('ready','running','validating')
RETURNING id,status;

UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs
SET status='failed',error_code=left($3::text,80),error_message=left($4::text,500),
 input_tokens=coalesce(($5::jsonb->>'input_tokens')::bigint,input_tokens),
 cached_input_tokens=coalesce(($5::jsonb->>'cached_input_tokens')::bigint,cached_input_tokens),
 output_tokens=coalesce(($5::jsonb->>'output_tokens')::bigint,output_tokens),
 reasoning_output_tokens=coalesce(($5::jsonb->>'reasoning_output_tokens')::bigint,reasoning_output_tokens),
 artifacts=artifacts || $6::jsonb,
 validation_summary=validation_summary || jsonb_build_object('runner_status','failed','error_code',left($3::text,80),'recorded_at',now()),
 poll_owner_execution_id=NULL,poll_claimed_at=NULL,updated_at=now()
WHERE id=$1::uuid AND poll_owner_execution_id=$2::text AND status IN ('ready','running','validating')
RETURNING id,status,error_code;
